id.description: Stable case id, e.g. 'case-001-rachana-1on1'. Referenced in reports.

audio.description: Path to the meeting clip (WAV, >=30 s, 48 kHz preferred). Relative to this file.

reference.description: Path to the hand-checked reference transcript (.txt, plain text, one utterance per line optional). Relative to this file.

roster.description: Path to roster.txt: one attendee display name per line, organizer first. Relative to this file. Used by diarize_audit.py for name-event scoring; omit if diarization scoring is not run for this case.

engine.description: Engine that produced the hypothesis, e.g. 'whisper-1', 'whisper-1+p0-2', 'gpt-4o-transcribe'. Free-form.

prompt.description: The biasing prompt sent with the request (empty for baseline). Recorded so A/B results are attributable.

notes.description: Free-form notes: which hard names this case exercises, diarization failure flags, etc.

hard_names.description: Known-hard names this case is designed to exercise (Rachana, Sapta/Saptaparni, Anando, Mukesh Marodia, Krishnan, ...).
